map.垃圾袋尺寸计算器按垃圾桶口长宽、桶高、垃圾重量与外翻余量，计算袋口所需周长、推荐: The calculator uses bin opening length and width, bin height, waste weight and overhang to compute the required opening circumference, recommended flat width, bag length, suggested thickness and bag volume, then compares common bag types for households, property management and food-service purchasing.
map.填入日常垃圾重量与尖锐/硬物占比。厨房湿垃圾、玻璃瓶、竹签较多时，尖锐物占比取: Enter the daily waste weight and the share of sharp or hard items. For kitchen wet waste, glass bottles or bamboo skewers, use a sharp-item share of 30%–50%.

map.用卷尺量出垃圾桶口的内长、内宽与桶内高，填入工具；圆桶可量袋口直径，按 C =: Use a tape measure to record the inner opening length, inner width and inner height of the bin. For a round bin, measure the opening diameter and convert to circumference with C = π × D.
map.袋口所需周长 C = 2 ×（桶口长 L + 桶口宽 W）；平口袋折径 ≈ C: Required opening circumference C = 2 × (opening length L + opening width W); flat bag width ≈ C ÷ 2; required bag length ≈ bin height H + opening width W ÷ 2 + overhang. Bin volume = L × W × H ÷ 1000 (liters). Recommended bag volume is about 1.2× bin volume to leave filling and closure room. Thickness is selected by waste weight and increases with the sharp-item share.

map.袋长要覆盖桶高、桶底短边的一半和外翻余量。桶越深、桶口越宽，袋底需要更多长度才能: Bag length must cover bin height, half the short side of the bin bottom and overhang. Deeper bins and wider openings need more length to lie flat; add 3–5 cm handling allowance to the calculated result.
